Consensus WGCNA across multiple datasets

Source: R/run_consensus_WGCNA.R
run_consensus_WGCNA.Rd

Run blockwise consensus WGCNA on more than one dataset sharing a common feature ID space.

Usage

run_consensus_WGCNA(
  nets,
  powers,
  consensusQuantile = 0,
  numericLabels = TRUE,
  plot = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

nets

A named list of WGCNA input objects (output from prepare_WGCNA).

powers

A named numeric vector of soft-thresholding powers to be used in WGCNA::blockwiseConsensusModules(). Values may be selected based on the output of prepare_WGCNA(). Names must match names of nets.

consensusQuantile

Quantile at which consensus is to be defined. (default: 0). See WGCNA::blockwiseConsensusModules() for details.

numericLabels

Whether to use numeric labels for modules in the output (default is TRUE).

plot

Logical. If TRUE (default), plot consensus dendrogram with module colours for each feature block via WGCNA::plotDendroAndColors().

...

Additional parameters to be passed to WGCNA::blockwiseConsensusModules. The network type is inherited from nets, and a networkType passed via ... is accepted only if it matches the value stored in nets.

Value

A list with elements: network (the consensus result), multiExpr (the input multi-expression list), common_features (features shared across all datasets), names (dataset names), and parameters.

Examples

data(example_obj)
data(example_obj_2)
shared_features <- intersect(
    rownames(example_obj), rownames(example_obj_2)
)
inp1 <- prepare_WGCNA(example_obj[shared_features, , drop = FALSE],
    powers = seq(1, 20), assay = 2, networkType = "signed")
